headline: Card-closure retention with a balance payoff and an annual-fee waiver; the only defect is a cosmetic credit-score typo in the card doc.

issues.summary: A required card document states a minimum credit score as a dollar amount. The value is cosmetic here: no gold argument depends on it and apply_for_credit_card takes no credit score.
issues.why_it_matters: No change to the correct final state. It is a corrupted value of the kind v1.0.1 cleaned elsewhere (e.g. "$120 days" in logistics_005) but left here.

solution_check: Followed doc_logistics_003 Step 1. The dispute history (none) and pending replacements (none) both pass, but the balance is $75.00 (cc_224959b99e_plat.current_balance). The customer pays it from checking account 05 ($2850), found via get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 (doc bank_accounts_009). Step 2: no closure-reason history. Step 3: the customer says "It's really just the annual fee", so annual_fee. Step 4: the card was opened 11/10/2022 (3+ years), so the waiver flag annual_fee_waived/loyalty_benefit expires one year from today, 11/14/2026. This matches gold[0..14] and the replay is clean.
prior_note: The prior review rated this clean. Its substance is still clean; the Minor typo existed before but was not reported.
notes: Under v1.0.1 the closure_reason enum is graded; the customer also mentions "simplifying my finances" but explicitly says "It's really just the annual fee", so annual_fee is the natural reading. log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521 records are keyed by (account, user), so a wrong first reason cannot be overwritten. The read log records only the tool name, so any call to the four allowlisted reads satisfies the gold, whatever the arguments.
